long_biography.plain_text:
Cordero trained as an industrial engineer at the University of Chile and began his career at Banco Nacional. His move into property development started around Lake Villarrica. He represented Inmobiliaria Santa María Ambienta on the Santa Adela housing scheme, while the group's Parque Mackenna development brought a larger residential project to Santiago.

Plans to build in Florida unravelled before the proposed buildings were constructed. As financial pressure mounted in 2022, Cordero sought liquidation of Ambienta's construction arm and said he would sell its US sites and cede stakes in several Chilean developments. He remains the recorded manager of a Florida development company.
long_biography.html:
Cordero trained as an industrial engineer at the University of Chile and began his career at Banco Nacional. His move into property development started around Lake Villarrica. He represented Inmobiliaria Santa María Ambienta on the Santa Adela housing scheme, while the group's Parque Mackenna development brought a larger residential project to Santiago.

Plans to build in Florida unravelled before the proposed buildings were constructed. As financial pressure mounted in 2022, Cordero sought liquidation of Ambienta's construction arm and said he would sell its US sites and cede stakes in several Chilean developments. He remains the recorded manager of a Florida development company.
